title: Coldfog Marches - Emberward Pushing Through
_note: Drained-zone 'as it relights' variant - Emberward burns the coldfog back, bells and warmth bleed into the hollow drone. gbc 4-voice band. 74 BPM (intentionally below gbc 80 floor - accept slow-tempo warning), 4/4, A minor warming toward C major. 24 bars. Vesper motif: the fragmented motif finally RESOLVES - the settle-home phrase (E4->D4->C4) that guttered out in A completes for the first time, in warming major. lead=faltering melody finding its footing, phrases begin to complete. harmony=hopeful pulse12 bell notes creep IN over the detuned drone, warming/steadying it. bass=tri_bass lifts off its single root into a gentle walk. drums=soft slow heartbeat kick appears and steadies. Last bar G(V) -> warm pull back into A-minor top that is now thawing.

tracks._note: Phrases begin to complete. Rising leap E3->A3->B3 early; the settle-home E4->D4->C4 completes in warming major from bar 17.
